about.title: About Soheil
about.body1: Soheil Faghih Nasiri is a guitarist, composer, and music instructor based in France. His playing moves between classical guitar repertoire — Segovia, Merlin — and electric guitar covers shaped by players like Gary Moore, alongside original compositions rooted in Persian musical traditions.
about.body2: Alongside performing and recording, Soheil teaches guitar and music, working with students one phrase, one technique at a time.
